title: The No AI Slop Manifesto: A Pledge to Own What Agents Ship
description: The No AI Slop Manifesto explained: what the slop manifesto says, why it appeared now, and what its beliefs mean for Python developers using AI.
summary: The No AI Slop Manifesto is a short statement from the speakers and attendees of the AIE Code Summit 2026. It defines AI slop and commits everyone who signs it to owning the work they ship with AI.
